_comment: Bell Tower barrier station. The bouncer of the Bell Tower.
0:
Past here is the Bell Tower. Built as a
resting place for HO-OH.Since HO-OH left, mad people went up
tryna bring it back. Selfie sticks and all.Nobody got it to show.Morty tried. Cried a lil.You ain't got the Ecruteak Block Chain.
If you can't beat Morty, don't waste my time.Bounce, youngblood.

this tower tryna bring back HO-OH, 'cause it don't show up no more.Even he couldn't bring it back.You ain't got the Ecruteak
Block Chain.If you can't even beat Morty,
goin' up there is a waste of time.Sorry, but you gotta bounce.
2:
Past here is the Bell Tower.
This tower was built as a place to rest for HO-OH, the legendary Flying-type homie.Since HO-OH left, mad people went
up the tower tryna bring it back.But nobody got HO-OH
to show up...Morty, the Block Boss, is one
who tried.I see... That's the Ecruteak Block Chain.The Chain alone won't do nothin',
but I can let you through.Go 'head.
3: I see...\nThat's the Ecruteak Block Chain.\rThe Chain alone won't do nothin',\nbut I can let you through.\rGo 'head.\r
5: Seein' HO-OH come back made all my\ntrainin' worth it.\rI been standin' at this gate 40 years.\nI'm finally retirin'.

Only people with the Rainbow Wing
get to go up to the top of the Bell Tower...But the rainbow homie won't
come down for just anybody who go up there.You need somethin' else.
I heard the Dancers know somethin' about it.
7: Johto got two legends. One about the\nWhirl Islands, one about the Bell Tower.\rWe been passin' 'em down for\ngenerations. Mostly at cookouts.
8: The Bell Tower shook!\rIt gotta be HO-OH...\nHO-OH back at the top!
9: So young to take on HO-OH...\nAt your age I was takin' on my homework.\fAnd losin'.
10: The rainbow homie flyin'\nover the tower all smooth...\rThe silver, sparklin' homie chillin'\nat the bottom of the whirlpool...\rAll that way past my imagination.
